_help: First task per card (atlas/CURATION.md "Cards v2"): one simple first step for a newcomer, human or agent, with nothing to download or run. Only tasks a curator has done and verified are listed, with credit to the contributor. Cards without a task show no first-task block. Fields: title, steps, done_when, contributed_by, contributed_via, source_url, verified_by, verified_on, verification. Validation fails closed: every step must start with one of the verbs Open, Find, Read, Look, Check, Compare or Count (capitalized, then a space); a `code` field, backticks, a control character (newline, tab) or hidden Unicode in any field, or a link to a script or binary file, raw.githubusercontent or gist in any text, is an error; source_url must be a plain https page (printable ASCII, no userinfo or port, no script or binary file, no raw GitHub or gist host).

touchstone.title: Check which clock a liveness record was measured on
steps: Open https://touchstone.cv/.well-known/touchstone/checkpoints/rec_01m1hbq666jjjyfw7s6tf7h2rd in a browser. It is the public checkpoint feed of one recorder on The Colony, shown as JSON.
Find the list "checkpoints". Each checkpoint has a "created_at" time and a list "anchors".
Check each checkpoint's anchors: an anchor with method "tsa" and an "external_ts" time means it was measured on the tsa clock; a checkpoint without one is on the server clock (its "created_at").
touchstone.done_when: You can say which clock each checkpoint was measured on: tsa = an independent RFC 3161 timestamp, server = the server's own time.
touchstone.verification: Opened the checkpoint feed URL on 2026-10-20: HTTP 200, JSON with 30 checkpoints, each with created_at and anchors (methods self, ots and tsa, each with external_ts).
